entries.name: Brute Force
entries.summary: Adversaries guess credentials when passwords are unknown or hashes are obtained.

entries.name: Brute Force: Password Guessing
entries.summary: Repeated password attempts against a single account.

entries.name: Brute Force: Password Spraying
entries.summary: A few common passwords tried against many accounts to avoid lockouts.

entries.name: Brute Force: Credential Stuffing
entries.summary: Credentials from breach dumps tried against other services.

entries.name: Valid Accounts
entries.summary: Adversaries use legitimate credentials to gain or keep access.

entries.name: Email Collection: Email Forwarding Rule
entries.summary: Mailbox rules that forward mail to an adversary-controlled address.

entries.name: Data from Network Shared Drive
entries.summary: Reading files from network shares to collect data of interest.

entries.name: Microsoft Outlook elevation of privilege
entries.summary: Crafted message can make Outlook for Windows leak the user's NTLM hash to a remote server.

entries.name: Apache Log4j2 remote code execution (Log4Shell)
entries.summary: JNDI lookups in log messages allow remote code execution in affected Log4j2 versions.

entries.name: Netlogon elevation of privilege (Zerologon)
entries.summary: Netlogon protocol flaw lets an attacker on the network take over a domain controller.
